caveat: Canadian schooling context; transfer to Dutch hbo partnerships needs argument.
title: Empowered to Lead: Afrocentric Youth Participatory Action Research and the Transformative Possibilities of Black Youth Knowledge Production
venue: The Canadian Journal of Action Research
why: YPAR framed through Afrocentric epistemology rather than generic 'youth voice' - a concrete case of whose knowledge counts, usable in the CDC Urban Innovation course.
